_note: Scores, weighted score, hard fails and fixes as the judge returned them; each why is abridged by the run from the judge's report.

criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Two frames pass the showstopper test (1, 5); 9 bold with a mannequin worker; 2, 3, 6, 7 and 8 fall back on defaults; 4's relief measured but its shadows alias.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Two devices work; 3 and 8 are cold worlds; value strobes, with 6, 7, 8 mid tone in a row.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; 'four properties' omits c15; Gillingham kicker over 'made only in Sugar Land'; Fort Bend from c13 missing from the first comment, whose 'two official records' counts the 10-Q twice.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, where and the clock are clear; no slide names Applied Optoelectronics; nothing to act on.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe; 2 delays; 8 after the turn; 9 restates.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean house style, reads as a filings summary; 'drawn to illustrate' on seven of nine.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: New topic; moves familiar from nos. 56, 59, 62 and 68.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild slides 2, 7 and 8 inside the cover's world: module across a gold tape corner with fingers in frame, transformer through the planned dark jamb, modules seated in port cages under one warm key.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat mid-tone gradient, knife read, fingers cropped, no tape corner.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Fingers and tape corner inside the frame at lower centre on dark epoxy in the door stripe.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Cold blue-grey hall; modules hung as a chain across the rack faces.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Seat modules in port cages on one switch, kill the blue fill, one warm key.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Halo hard hat, blown yard, no jamb, decal gravel.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Dark jamb across the left third, cut or silhouette the figure, lower apron exposure.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Ripple ground reads as water, flat horizon band, rigid V flagging.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Graded clay with ruts, stage into a dark sky, limp ribbons.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Blue night palette, trailer doors brightest, stripe clerestory, unlit court.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Warm raking key, trailer doors to wall value, emissive panes, lit court pool.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Aliased long diagonal shadows become a black band.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Higher resolution shadow with softening, raise key elevation.
